target_semantics: Historical used-car listing asking price in INR, not a verified transaction price or guaranteed market valuation.

evaluation.method: 5-fold GroupKFold grouped by Standardized car model
evaluation.purpose: Estimates generalization to model families not present in each training fold; not a future-time split.
evaluation.selection_rationale: Random Forest has lower mean MAE than Linear Regression in GroupKFold, while Linear Regression has lower mean RMSE and higher mean R2. Selection prioritizes MAE; this is a trade-off, not a win on every metric.

output_safeguard: Displayed predictions are clipped at zero if the model produces a negative value; requires_review is true for a negative raw prediction.
data_quality_notes: The source data contains historical listing asking prices, not verified completed-sale prices.
Some vehicle model families have limited observations and premium-car errors can be large.
Repeated similar listings were observed; exact duplicate identity has not been established for every repeated listing.
The catalog is bundled locally under data/manufacturer_model_catalog.csv so the app and API do not depend on a sibling training-bundle directory.
training_library_version: Unknown (the serialized artifact produced a version-mismatch warning when loaded)
notes: The saved Random Forest artifact was already present in the uploaded ZIP; it was not retrained because the standardized training CSV was not included in the ZIP.
GroupKFold metrics are fold averages and should not be presented as a guaranteed error for an individual prediction.
Re-evaluate after the training dataset and duplicate-aware review are finalized.
